extract_prefix_by_tracing: extract the constant text prefix from a program by tracing with dummy arguments
trace_program: trace a program with arguments and backend to produce a tracer state with all execution nodes
create_tracer_program_state: create a tracer program state that executes SGLang expressions and tracks variables and nodes
fork_tracer_program_state: fork a tracer program state into multiple child states for branching execution paths
use_tracing_scope: use a tracing scope context manager to track the current tracer state across nested program executions
